title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/campaign/mutations.yaml
description: The purchase rules and the mutation list of the Chaos warbands. A mutation is prose plus its listed price; the mutations a concrete warrior carries are campaign state. `effect` is the source text, not a typed operation, because no engine evaluates a mutation yet — the schema says so instead of pretending otherwise.

grant_rules.description: Printed band rules that grant a mutation. Each one names the band, its rule, who may receive a mutation and the mutation ids the rule lists; the ids the rule names but the catalogue does not publish are listed by name instead of invented.

effect_ids.description: Effects of this catalogue a warband's own special rules may modify.

purchase_rules.description: When and at what price a mutation may be bought.

timing.description: When a mutation may be bought. Currently only at recruitment, as the source states.

pricing.description: How the listed price of a mutation is applied.

first_mutation.description: Price of the first mutation a warrior takes.

second_and_subsequent.description: Price of every later mutation, as the source states it.

mutation.description: One mutation: the listed price and the source text of its effect.

id.description: Stable mutation id of the `campaign.mutation.*` family.

cost_gc.description: Listed price in gold crowns, before the purchase rule's doubling.

grant_rule.description: One printed grant of mutations: the recipients and the catalogue ids the rule lists.

rule_id.description: Printed band rule the grant transcribes.

recipients.description: Who the printed rule grants a mutation to. Currently only Heroes, as the source states.

profile_ids.description: Recipient profiles; empty when the printed rule names none.

mutation_ids.description: Catalogue mutation ids the printed rule lists.

unrouted_mutation_names.description: Mutation names the printed rule lists that the catalogue does not publish (no listed price in the available sources).

limit_per_warrior.description: Printed per-warrior cap, when the source states one.
